name: FireSight
description: FireSight is a self-hosted firewall log analyzer and syslog dashboard for UniFi routers (UDR / UDM / UXG / Cloud Gateway). Acts as a syslog server on UDP/514, parses UniFi firewall, STA-tracker and internal events, enriches them with GeoIP and threat intelligence (AbuseIPDB + offline FireHOL/Spamhaus blocklists), and serves a fast dark NOC-style web UI with FTS5-backed search. Single container — no separate database, no extra services. SQLite (WAL + FTS5) keeps searches snappy even on large log volumes. Features: - Syslog UDP/514 listener with UniFi RFC3164 + CEF parser - Real-time firewall log viewer with pause/resume, country + ASN, threat level - Internal events viewer (Wi-Fi roam, auth, DHCP, admin actions) in plain English - Full-text search across raw syslog (SQLite FTS5) - Per-minute event charts driven by the global time range - Pie charts for actions, categories, and external IP threat level - Optional UniFi API polling (read-only) for client name resolution - Configurable retention by age + DB size cap, hourly VACUUM - First-login forced password change, session cookie auth - Local timezone support via the TZ env var (router timestamps lack a TZ field)

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent storage. Holds the SQLite database (unifi.db) and config.json (UniFi credentials, retention settings, auto-generated session secret).

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the FireSight web UI. Host networking is used so this also binds on the host.

ports.name: Syslog UDP Port
ports.description: UDP port the syslog listener binds to. Point your UniFi router's remote syslog here.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for interpreting UniFi syslog timestamps (RFC3164 has no TZ field). Must match the timezone your router is configured in.

variables.name: Default Admin User
variables.description: Seed username for the first login. You'll be forced to change the password on first login.

variables.name: Default Admin Password
variables.description: Seed password for the first login (forced change on first login).

variables.name: Retention Days (Syslog)
variables.description: Drop syslog rows older than N days. Can also be changed from Settings in the UI.

variables.name: Max DB Size (MB)
variables.description: Hard cap on on-disk SQLite size. When exceeded, the oldest syslog rows are pruned to fit.
